source.title: In Search of Cellular Automata that Preserve Numbers: Advances, Limitations, and Open Problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 8157923. The local resolver rows in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv and outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-1.csv identify the exact work as Wolnik, Bołt, and De Baets, "In Search of Cellular Automata that Preserve Numbers: Advances, Limitations, and Open Problems," with DOI 10.1007/978-3-032-01570-9_4. Direct browser access to https://zbmath.org/8157923 did not expose a readable document in the available tools. Shell recovery against api.zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution failure in the sandbox, and the browsable zbMATH API root only exposed a terms page rather than a readable document record.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted plus metadata_only. The DOI resolved to the Springer chapter page for the same exact work, which exposed the title, authors, abstract, references, pages 43-58, DOI, publication metadata, and purchase/login controls, but explicitly presented the chapter as preview/subscription content and did not expose the full technical body or complete open-problem statements. DBLP, J-GLOBAL, local resolver rows, and bookstore/library pages were metadata-only. Bounded exact-work recovery searched the exact DOI, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus arXiv, exact title plus authors/AUTOMATA, and the DBLP key conf/automata/WolnikBB25; candidates were metadata-only, paywalled, snippets, or different works. No questions were extracted from abstracts, citation metadata, link labels, or search snippets.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/8157923.json and mirrored it to outputs/latest.json.
